تجتازوا (form VIII)
# تَجْتَازُوا (tajtāzū) /tad͡ʒ.taː.zuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِجْتَازَ (ijtāza)
# تُجْتَازُوا (tujtāzū) /tud͡ʒ.taː.zuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِجْتَازَ (ijtāza)
